fourthMirrorAudit.question: can an ordinary, allowed training-camp kill write the attack-speed asMult mirror?
fourthMirrorAudit.source: packages/server/src/sim/mobLife.ts payMobKill starts with `if (world.config.training) return;` (line 252), before creditMobKill and before `grantMobStat(..., MOB_KILL_STACKS)` (line 265).
fourthMirrorAudit.reward: shared/mobStats.ts gives plagueRat and frostbowSentry `stat attackSpeed v 0.01`; MOB_KILL_STACKS is 3, so one credited ordinary kill would be +3% attack speed (wire +30).
fourthMirrorAudit.observedBlocker: A real training camp kill never reaches grantMobStat, so mobStats stays empty and asMult stays the identity 1000. `train stat` is a direct console set and was not used; no base card or fake stat was granted.
fourthMirrorAudit.conclusion: Only an arena/ordinary non-training credited kill of plagueRat or frostbowSentry (or a practice kill in a non-training world) can write that mirror; this continuation records the bounded refusal, not a produced mirror.
